units.source_text: 这是个多么巨大的精灵祭啊！

en.t: What an immense festival of spirits this is!

units.source_text: 今年长成的瓜是精灵，茄子也是精灵，加茂川的水是精灵，

en.t: The melons that ripened this year are spirits, the eggplants are spirits too, and the water of the Kamo River is a spirit,

units.source_text: 柿和梨也是精灵，死者是精灵，生者也是精灵，祭祀人也是精灵。

en.t: persimmons and pears are spirits too, the dead are spirits, the living are spirits too, and the people who perform the rites are also spirits.

units.source_text: 这些精灵聚拢起来，无牵无挂，但难得相逢，只是把一体的精灵祭法则称为一心法界的说法。

en.t: These spirits gather together, free of all attachments, yet their meeting is rare; this is simply the teaching that calls the law of the unified spirit festival the Dharma realm of one mind.

units.source_text: 因为法界则是一心，一心则是法界。

en.t: For the Dharma realm is one mind, and one mind is the Dharma realm.
It is a festival in which grasses, trees, and the whole land all become Buddha.

units.source_text: 天地万物死者活者无不是精灵，这些精灵聚集一堂。

en.t: In heaven and earth, all things, the dead and the living alike, are nothing other than spirits, and these spirits gather in one place.

units.source_text: 虚空与此身境界相隔离，故而不见无心境界的活动。

en.t: Because empty space is separated from the realm of this body, one cannot see the movements of the realm of no mind.
